definitions: Adolf Hitler (1889–1945), German politician and leader of the Nazi Party, Chancellor of Germany from 1933 to 1945 and Führer of Nazi Germany from 1934 to 1945.
A person resembling or compared to Adolf Hitler, especially in being a tyrannical, authoritarian, or genocidal leader.
examples: Hitler rose to power in the 1930s.
He was accused of being a little Hitler in the workplace.
